# Aurelius Sovereign Orchestrator - LLM Workspace Map
> Repository-level context map for high-integrity orchestration, code synthesis, and socioeconomic node tracking.

This file provides a structured view of the Aurelius Sovereign Orchestrator (AURELIUS V7), a premium full-stack control matrix connecting an Express.js backend simulation framework to a highly responsive React client dashboard. Created by Master Architect Joshua (JHammerZ).

## 1. System Philosophy (The Sovereign Paradigm)
* **Tier 0 Absolute Authority**: Standard operating controls are elevated automatically to maximum authorization levels by default.
* **12-Node Cluster Synchronizer**: Live simulation of distributed network nodes (N01 to N12) verifying cryptographic blocks, performance baselines, and security.
* **14 socioeconomic Distribution Channels**: Tracks latency, secure keys, and link statuses for JHammerZ's canonical public web ports (Canonical Portfolio, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, etc.).
* **Zero-Leak Airgap Design**: Low-latency, memory-sealed processing with detailed simulation overlays (Write-Ahead Logs, LMAX Disruptors, Homomorphic Enclaves, and Physical Faraday structures).

## 2. Directory Structure & Key Files
* `/server.ts`: Full Express backend setup. Initializes Google GenAI client (`@google/genai` on model `gemini-3.5-flash`), configures the 12-node cluster simulations, coordinates the Multi-Agent Cognitive Cascades, signs cryptographic transaction hashes, and serves the static production build.
* `/src/App.tsx`: Central hub component for the UI dashboard. Handles state tracking, theme alignments, custom direct actions, local storage bindings, and layouts.
* `/src/components/SovereignBrainConsole.tsx`: Sandbox testing area for adjusting neural coefficients, deploying homomorphic operations, testing ring buffers, and pulsing seismic geography sync messages.
* `/src/components/SovereignTuningPanel.tsx`: 14 socioeconomic nodes management panel. Custom-tuned sliders for frequency, pitch, octaves, latency offsets, and algorithm selection.
* `/src/components/AIChat.tsx`: Floating interactive interface to query the virtual AI Orchestrator thread.
* `/src/components/PipelineStatus.tsx`: Verification unit tracing visual CI/CD build states.
* `/src/components/SingularityVisualizer.tsx`: Beautiful canvas-driven wave representing quantum resonance feedback loops.

## 3. Environment Declarations
All server transactions sign state updates with standard `SOVEREIGN_ROOT_SECRET` hashes. Requires:
* `GEMINI_API_KEY`: Server-side secret key to enable active model-driven cognitive cascades (model: `gemini-3.5-flash`).

## 4. API Boundaries
* `GET /api/node{1..12}`: Realtime system telemetry answers.
* `GET /api/cdm/manifest`: Custom domain schema mapping Joshua's public profiles.
* `POST /api/chat`: Dedicated chat endpoint utilizing the GenAI Chat SDK.
* `POST /api/node/cascade`: Spawns multi-agent workflow simulated with Gemini.
* `POST /api/node/lock-state`: Handles universal permanent alignment locking across the core.
